description: Compact, trace-free metric export of the DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1200-second 36-pair validation (12 validation tasks x 3 repetitions x 2 variants = 72 attempts). Zero token placeholders are not actual zero usage when token_usage_available is false. The full raw file (with agent/grader logs and traces) remains in the autoresearch workspace and is pinned by source_sha256.

protocol.cost_method: OpenRouter GET /api/v1/key usage delta around each variant; key-wide and overlapping intervals in parallel mode, so per-variant deltas are not attributable or additive; terminal token usage may be unavailable
protocol.execution_order: up to 3 task pairs active; baseline and candidate simultaneous within each pair
